steps.text: Talk to Morgan in the north of Draynor Village.

Get garlic from the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's house.

You can tick off this section in the sidebar to skip the garlic acquisition.
Talk to Dr. Harlow in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
Buy a beer from the bartender in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
choices: A glass of your finest ale please.

steps.text: Talk to Dr. Harlow again with a beer.
Prepare to fight Count Draynor (level 34), and enter Draynor Manor.
Open the coffin and kill Count Draynor.
